text_block_list.text:
—The Expedition Support Committee room. 
The uncontrollable horse girls who made it 
their lair were bickering amongst 
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, ya bastards! If we're gettin' 
another bus for away trips, a Dekotora's 
the only damn choice!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Not to my taste. Rejected. Spend the 
effort making the interior lavish instead.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
A deco-truck... or rather, a deco-bus 
feels much more fitting for a wandering 
gambler, if you ask me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to draw attention 
purposely. Yet, as Orfevre says...

With no resolution in sight, the dispute 
spilled outside the room—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If that's how it's gonna be, let's settle 
it with a bet. ――A game of poker.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, not at all. In that case, I shall 
prepare the cards we will be using.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What in the w-o-o-r-l-d are you 
d-o-i-n-g?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Gambling in broad daylight in the middle 
of Tracen Academy is utterly outrageous! 
No, even if it were at night!

Even the disciplinary committee jumped 
into the fray. Yet despite that, the 
discussion showed no signs of reaching a 
resolution...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, wouldn't it be great if the most 
important person there just made a firm, 
final decision?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Still, who's the top dog here~? They're 
all some of the absolute strongest 
Umamusume around, aren't they?

It seemed unlikely that anyone would be 
able to decide—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...What's the matter? What happened?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Sis. Truth is, we got into a bit of 
a scrape...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's how it is... In that 
case――

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Decorations are pointless. Interior, 
exterior—sooner or later, you'll tire of 
both.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
To make up for it, let's make it super 
comfy. With extra plush, fluffy seats.

A calm reply, without a hint of a 
commanding tone. Even so, pushback seemed 
inevitable, but...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey & Nakayama
text_block_list.text: —As you command. ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre & Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Cheh...

A gathering full of shrewd eccentrics. Yet 
the discussion was settled in the blink of 
an eye……

Stay Gold. The reason her words carry such 
decisive weight is――

Stay Gold. The reason her words carry such 
decisive weight is――

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Feared, huh? I don't really think I've 
done anything to scare people, though.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
So... you see, they're not afraid of you 
after all. Right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship & Nakayama
text_block_list.text: Ah... ――Heh.

Reactions varied. Yet no one said yes. 
Having no answer—was an answer in itself.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Loved, huh? I never really thought of it 
like that, but...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as for us, we are certainly counting 
on you, you know?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
By the way――Stay Gold. If you have 
returned from your travels, there is a 
matter I wish to discuss.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, cheap move, Orfe! I'm telling you, 
you've gotta taste my new squid-ghetti 
first!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, alright, alright! Let's just take 
care of it all at once.

All the highly individualistic Umamusume 
gathered here seemed to look up to her 
with deep respect.
